purpose: Accepted functional SWD short-high workaround for current F103CB/wiring; analog mechanism unconfirmed.
source_commit_note: The source_commit contains the exact compiled RTL/firmware and paired artifacts. Board captures retain the earlier dirty-tree HEAD and exact artifact hashes from the actual run.

acceptance.SWD: PASS 43 requested rates, 250kHz..60MHz, each 3 or 5 rounds of 4096-byte random SRAM write/read and verified restoration; 724992 bytes each direction total; RCC unchanged
acceptance.JTAG: PASS requests 250kHz/1/10/30/50/60MHz, block write/read and unaligned read, SRAM restored; actual TCK from 249999 to 59999999Hz; 50MHz request calibrated to 44999999Hz
acceptance.RTT: PASS 1/15/50MHz requests; 19965 byte-exact CDC bytes each, cold initialization, realized-clock report verified, SRAM restored
acceptance.HSS: PASS at 15/50MHz requests, v1/v2 single variable and v2 eight variables, byte-exact frames, DAP context, counted intentional backpressure, realized-clock report and SRAM restore
acceptance.CM3: PASS minimum 250kHz, 1/2/17-word blocks; delayed-return late profile 1/2/127/256/770/1023-word blocks and RTT/HSS; pad high-width assertions
acceptance.main_pair_control: At fixed FCLK119999998Hz and SWCLK9999999.833Hz, only CFG[19] changed: high50ns FAIL, high8.333ns PASS, FAIL, PASS
acceptance.host: PASS production service/target/USB descriptor/JTAG calibration C tests

Late boundary with Q2 above actual25MHz failed requests27/28/29MHz. Q1 needed for reliable block transfers.

limitations: Current F103CB/wiring acceptance only; no target-pad analog measurements or confirmed physical root cause.
Narrow pad high_ns values are RTL/FCLK requests, not oscilloscope measurements. Tested requests produce approximately8.333..12.778ns high times.
HSS existing minimum requested clock15MHz and RTT minimum1MHz unchanged. DAP minimum250kHz.
The original minimum-rate simulation false PASS was a testbench polling timeout plus a runner accepting partial PASS before Fatal; both were corrected and the minimum case rerun fully.
Performance/backpressure observations do not establish universal zero skipped samples.
